SDL_mixer 1.2.12 for 32-bit MinGW-w64 (i686)
MSYS2 package: mingw-w64-i686-SDL_mixer-1.2.12-9-any.pkg.tar.zst

Bundled development files:
- include/SDL/SDL_mixer.h
- lib/libSDL_mixer.dll.a
- lib/libSDL_mixer.a
- lib/pkgconfig/SDL_mixer.pc
- bin/libSDL_mixer-1-2-0.dll
- share/licenses/SDL_mixer/LICENSE

The DLL is PE32/i386. Its direct imports include SDL.dll, libmad-0.dll,
and libgcc_s_dw2-1.dll, in addition to Windows system DLLs. SDL.dll is
bundled under deps/SDL-1.2.15/bin and copied to the project bin directory.
The libmad runtime DLL and the MinGW GCC runtime are not included in this
SDL_mixer package payload; they must be supplied by the matching MinGW32
runtime installation or copied to the game bin directory for a standalone
runtime distribution. Optional codec backends may require additional codec
DLLs from the package dependencies (FLAC, Vorbis and MikMod).

No SDL_mixer source or game simulation code is modified by this package
integration.
